name: BME280 breakout (GY-BME280, 3.3 V, I2C)
blurb: Measures temperature, humidity and air pressure over I2C; the small purple 4-pin GY-BME280 board.

pins.name: VCC
pins.note: 3.3 V only on this board. The BME280 chip runs from 1.71 to 3.6 V and its absolute maximum is 4.25 V (Bosch datasheet), so never use the 5 V pin on a bare 3.3 V board. Boards sold as 3.3 V to 5 V have an extra regulator, but you cannot tell from the outside: use 3.3 V.

pins.name: SCL
pins.note: I2C clock. 3.3 V logic: use a level shifter from 5 V controllers.

search: BME280 temperature humidity pressure module 4 pin

verify: The board outline is NOT confirmed. Sellers of the GY-BME280 give 15.4 x 11.6 mm, 15.5 x 12 mm and 9 x 11 mm, and no source gives 15 x 11.5, so the modelled body, header position and sensor-can position are a guess within about 1 mm: measure length, width, header-to-edge distances, can position and PCB thickness (modelled 1.6) with calipers. Two 3.5 mm mounting holes are reported by several sellers on the 15 mm boards, not modelled here. Variants: this file is the 4-pin VCC GND SCL SDA board (the pin label may read VIN). 6-pin boards add CSB and SDO and some have an on-board regulator for 3.3 to 5 V; Adafruit's board is 25.2 x 18 mm with different pins and STEMMA QT; none of those fit this file. Chip facts from the Bosch datasheet: VDD 1.71 to 3.6 V, VDDIO 1.2 to 3.6 V, absolute maximum 4.25 V, interface pins at most VDDIO + 0.3 V, 3.6 uA at 1 Hz humidity + pressure + temperature, 0.1 uA sleep, SDO low = 0x76 and SDO high = 0x77, SDI/SCK need external pull-ups to VDDIO (so whether the module has them depends on the clone: check with a meter, i2cPullups is unconfirmed). Confirm the address with a scanner. A BMP280 sold as BME280 has no humidity: the BME280 can is square (2.5 x 2.5 mm) and the BMP280 can rectangular (2.0 x 2.5 mm), which is hard to judge by eye; the reliable test is chip ID register 0xD0, which reads 0x60 for BME280 and 0x58 for BMP280. Variant warning for sourcing: boards sold as "3.3V/5V" or "5 V version" carry a regulator and level shifting, are larger, and take up to 5 V on VIN; this file is the small 3.3 V-only GY-BME280. The only Norwegian listing found in the local parts catalog (robonordic.no item 499) is the 5 V version. If that is what arrives, override this part in the project with its real size and supply range.
sources: https://www.bosch-sensortec.com/media/boschsensortec/downloads/datasheets/bst-bme280-ds002.pdf (Bosch datasheet, opened: package 2.5 x 2.5 x 0.93 mm LGA, VDD 1.71-3.6 V, VDDIO 1.2-3.6 V, abs max 4.25 V, 3.6 uA at 1 Hz, address 0x76/0x77 by SDO, SDI needs external pull-up)
https://www.bosch-sensortec.com/products/environmental-sensors/humidity-sensors-bme280/ (Bosch product page: same package and supply figures)
